findings.evidence: `rg` shows the raw API has `Trivial.lean:117` and `Trivial.lean:124`, and the finite-type product wrapper re-exposes the same kind of API at `FiniteTypeProduct.lean:116` and `FiniteTypeProduct.lean:140`; `FiniteTypeTrivial.lean` stops after apply/symm/pointwise lemmas at lines 127-150.
findings.fix: Add finite-type wrapper lemmas analogous to `TrivialGroup.pointsMulEquiv_mapValue` and `TrivialGroup.mapValue_pointsMulEquiv_symm_apply`, using `AlgHom.mapValue (H := trivial R)`.
findings.issue: `trivialPointsMulEquiv` lacks the value-algebra naturality lemmas, so users of the finite-type wrapper must unfold back to `TrivialGroup.pointsMulEquiv` to prove functor-of-points compatibility.

summary: The finite-type trivial points equivalence is exposed without the functorial API needed for the stated functor-of-points target.
